reviewer_role: Independent whole-batch source quality reviewer; did not author candidates.
review_scope: One fresh whole-batch source-only quality review of the exact frozen original proposal. Author caches were navigation only. rubric_application.A: Recognition, selected-sense honesty, source verifiability and relevant material/use qualifiers assessed for every record. No adult framing, arbitrary regional association or newly approved round.
rubric_application.C: Concrete vocabulary and prospective typed input value assessed separately from targets. The ten new IDs have zero direct predecessors in this payload; four outgoing links each do not satisfy C3. Salience0.5 is not target qualification.
rubric_application.D: Readable outgoing association facts are not validated directed routes, choice profiles or approved Lanț rounds.
rubric_application.E: No seeds, combinations, recipe closure, par or Alchimie board approval. Source truth cannot establish intuitive crafting.
rubric_application.other_games: Aliases alone add no Intrusul predicate, Perechi pairing or Conexiuni partition. The existing board-ID input contracts remain separate.
